name: hud_ui_load_game_dialog_process_dialog_result
description: HudUiLoadGameDialog::ProcessDialogResult delegates to the common HudUiSaveLoadDialog result handler.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x434dc0 yet; current evidence covers the load-dialog tailcall wrapper only. The base HudUiSaveLoadDialog::ProcessDialogResult data/global gate remains pending.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x434dc0 is a tail jmp to 0x435a70 HudUiSaveLoadDialog::ProcessDialogResult.
The native smoke patches only HudUiSaveLoadDialog::ProcessDialogResult and verifies HudUiLoadGameDialog::ProcessDialogResult dispatches the same this pointer.
